posts.title: Three parks, one KH1, and a friend at Great Brook Farm
posts.description: Three parks, one KH1, and a friend at Great Brook Farm Much of my field operating lately has been with my Yaesu FT-891 , but I still love my Elecraft KH1 . posts.title: Remote FT8 from the couch with POTACAT and ECHOCAT
posts.description: Remote FT8 from the couch with POTACAT and ECHOCAT On Wednesday evening, October 28, 2026, I logged a two-way FT8 contact with Bulgaria while watching the World Series upstairs with my wife. My radio was in the basement the whole time. The station was LZ2XA , Val, in grid KN33, about 7,400 kilometers (4,600 miles) away on 40 meters. I made the contact from my phone. Why remote? posts.title: Island Operations talk at PART
posts.description: Island Operations talk at PART On Tuesday evening, October 20, 2026, I gave a talk at the monthly meeting of PART of Westford , my local radio club. The meeting had an island activation theme. I went first with “Island Operations: Activating Peddocks Island in Boston Harbor,” and Adam (AA1N) and James (NV1U) followed with their Cross Island, Maine expedition.
